OrderablePartNumber.Name: DAC3484 Quad-Channel, 16-Bit, 1.25 GSPS Digital-to-Analog Converter (DAC)
OrderablePartNumber.PartDescription:
The DAC3484 is a very low power, high dynamic range, quad-channel, 16-bit digital-to-analog converter (DAC) with a sample rate as high as 1.25 GSPS.
The device includes features that simplify the design of complex transmit architectures: 2× to 16× digital interpolation filters with over 90dB of stop-band attenuation simplify the data interface and reconstruction filters. Independent complex mixers allow flexible carrier placement. A high-performance low jitter clock multiplier simplifies clocking of the device without significant impact on the dynamic range. The digital Quadrature Modulator Correction (QMC) enables complete IQ compensation for gain, offset, phase and group delay between channels in direct up-conversion applications.
Digital data is input to the device through a 16-bit LVDS data bus with on-chip termination. The device includes a FIFO, data pattern checker and parity test to ease the input interface. The interface also allows full synchronization of multiple devices.
The device is characterized for operation over the entire industrial temperature range of –40°C to 85°C and is available in a very-small 88-pin 9x9mm WQFN package or 196-ball 12×12mm NFBGA package.
Very low power, small size, superior crosstalk, high dynamic range and features of the DAC3484 are an ideal fit for systems with multiple transmit channels.

DifferentialPair.Name: D0
DifferentialPair.DifferentialDescription: LVDS positive/negative input data bits 0 through 15. Internal 100-Ω termination resistor. Data format relative to DATACLKP/N clock is Double Data Rate (DDR). D15P is most significant data bit (MSB). D0P is least significant data bit (LSB). The order of the bus can be reversed via config2 revbus bit.

DifferentialPair.Name: DACCLK
DifferentialPair.DifferentialDescription: Positive/negative external LVPECL clock input for DAC core with a self-bias

DifferentialPair.Name: DATACLK
DifferentialPair.DifferentialDescription: LVDS positive/negative input data clock. Internal 100-Ω termination resistor. Input data D[15:0]P/N

DifferentialPair.Name: FRAME
DifferentialPair.DifferentialDescription: LVDS frame indicator positive/negative input. Internal 100-Ω termination resistor. The main functions of this input are to reset the FIFO pointer or to be used as a syncing source. These two functions are captured with the rising edge of DATACLKP/N. The signal captured by the falling edge of DATACLKP/N can be used as a block parity bit. The FRAMEP/N signal should be edge-aligned with D[15:0]P/N. Additionally it is used to indicate the beginning of the frame.

DifferentialPair.Name: IOUTA
DifferentialPair.DifferentialDescription: A-Channel DAC current output. Connect directly to ground if unused

DifferentialPair.Name: IOUTB
DifferentialPair.DifferentialDescription: B-Channel DAC current output. Connect directly to ground if unused.

DifferentialPair.Name: IOUTC
DifferentialPair.DifferentialDescription: C-Channel DAC current output. Connect directly to ground if unused.

DifferentialPair.Name: IOUTD
DifferentialPair.DifferentialDescription: D-Channel DAC current output. Connect directly to ground if unused.

DifferentialPair.Name: OSTR
DifferentialPair.DifferentialDescription: LVPECL output strobe positive/negative input. This positive/negative pair is captured with the rising edge of DACCLKP/N. It is used for multiple DAC synchronization. If unused it can be left unconnected.

DifferentialPair.Name: PARITY
DifferentialPair.DifferentialDescription: Optional LVDS positive input parity bit. The PARITYP/N LVDS pair has an internal 100-Ω termination resistor. If unused it can be left unconnected.

DifferentialPair.Name: SYNC
DifferentialPair.DifferentialDescription: Optional LVDS SYNC positive/negative input. The SYNCP/N LVDS pair has an internal 100-Ω termination resistor. If unused it can be left unconnected.

Terminal.TerminalDescription: AVDD - Analog supply voltage. (3.3 V)

ALARM - CMOS output for ALARM condition. The ALARM output functionality is defined through the config7 register. Default polarity is active low, but can be changed to active high via config0 alarm_out_pol control bit.
BIASJ - Full-scale output current bias. For 30-mA full-scale output current, connect 1.28 kΩ to ground. Change the full-scale output current through coarse_dac(3:0) in config3, bit<15:12>
CLCKVDD - Internal clock buffer supply voltage. (1.2 V) It is recommended to isolate this supply from DIGVDD and DACVDD.
DACVDD - DAC core supply voltage. (1.2 V). It is recommended to isolate this supply from CLKVDD and DIGVDD
DIGVDD - Digital supply voltage. (1.2 V). It is recommended to isolate this supply from CLKVDD and DACVDD

EXTIO - Used as external reference input when internal reference is disabled through config27 extref_ena = 1b. Used as internal reference output when config27 extref_ena = 0b (default). Requires a 0.1-µF decoupling capacitor to AGND when used as reference output.
GND - These pins are ground for all supplies.
IOVDD - Supply voltage for all digital I/O. (3.3 V)
LPF - PLL loop filter connection. If not using the clock multiplying PLL, the LPF pin can be left unconnected
PLLAVDD - PLL analog supply voltage. (3.3 V)
SCLK - Serial interface clock. Internal pull-down.
SDENB - Active low serial data enable, always an input to the DAC3484. Internal pull-up.
SDIO -Serial interface data. Bi-directional in 3-pin mode (default) and 4-pin mode. Internal pull-down
SDO -Uni-directional serial interface data in 4-pin mode. The SDO pin is three-stated in 3-pin interface mode (default).

SLEEP -Active high asynchronous hardware power-down input. Internal pull-down. If SLEEP pin is set to logic HIGH before and during device power-up and initialization, the fuse_sleep bit in register 0x1B, bit 11 must be written after register 0x23 during device initialization register setup.
RESETB -Active low input for chip RESET, which resets all the programming registers to their default state. Internal pull-up.

TXENABLE -Transmit enable active high input. Internal pull-down. To enable analog output data transmission, set sif_txenable in register config3 to 1b or pull CMOS TXENABLE pin to high. To disable analog output, set sif_txenable to 0b and pull CMOS TXENABLE pin to low. The DAC output is forced to midscale.
TESTMODE -This pin is used for factory testing. Internal pull-down. Leave unconnected for normal operation
VFUSE - Digital supply voltage. This supply pin is also used for factory fuse programming. Connect to DACVDD for normal operation.
N/C - Not Connected
